part.text: All jakarta-related paths are covered. Final verification of the complete diff:

Fixed. Summary of the changes:

1. **`NullAnnotationLibrary.java`** — added a `JAKARTA` library so `lombok.addNullAnnotations = jakarta` uses `jakarta.annotation.Nonnull` / `jakarta.annotation.Nullable` for annotations lombok generates itself (equals/canEqual params, toString return, constructors, with-ers, etc.).

2. **`HandlerUtil.java`** — added `jakarta.annotation.Nonnull` to `NONNULL_ANNOTATIONS` (so null checks are generated), and `jakarta.annotation.CheckForNull`, `jakarta.annotation.Nonnull`, `jakarta.annotation.Nullable` to `BASE_COPYABLE_ANNOTATIONS` — this is the core of the issue: these annotations are now always copied from fields to builder-setter/with-er parameters, getters, etc., regardless of the `lombok.addNullAnnotations` setting, matching the behavior of the javax/checkerframework annotations.

3. **`ConfigurationKeys.java`** — documented the new `jakarta` option.

Verified with `ant test.instance`: the previously failing `NullLibrary3` jakarta test now passes, and the 4 remaining failures are pre-existing record-delombok issues unrelated to this change (confirmed via baseline run with the fix stashed).
